setlist.info: Springsteen's fortieth birthday and a quite significant bash in historic terms. Present and backing Bruce at the party was the entire E Street Band and Steve Van Zandt. On this night the E Street Band members were completely unaware that in less than four weeks (October 18th 1989) Bruce would phone them individually to inform them he was putting the E Street Band into semi-retirement, effective immediately. This would turn out to be the last Springsteen and the E Street Band performance together for over five years (until January 1995).
